mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISHLIST(WISH_ID, USER_NO, PRODUCT_ID) VALUES(WISH_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{productId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WISHLIST WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT W.WISH_ID, W.USER_NO, W.PRODUCT_ID, TO_CHAR(W.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_STATE, P.PRODUCT_PLACE, PF.FILE_PATH AS MAIN_FILE_PATH, COALESCE(MP.NICKNAME, '알 수 없음') AS SELLER_NAME FROM WISHLIST W JOIN PRODUCT P ON W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND P.IS_DELETED = 'N' LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE PF ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PF.PRODUCT_ID AND PF.IS_MAIN = 1 LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MP ON P.USER_NO = MP.USER_NO WHERE W.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT USER_NO FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT COALESCE(NICKNAME, '알 수 없음') FROM MY_USER_PAGE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
